title: YAML Field
description: Catches YAML that loads without an error but means something else (NO, yes, on and off read as booleans, 1.10 read as 1.1, 0755 as octal, 22:22 as base-60, duplicate keys, tabs and misaligned indentation) by showing each one's line, column and what the parser will really read, with one-tap quoting and alignment fixes.
